statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); ∀ (q X : ℕ), 0 < q → 200*(q+1) ≤ X → (∃ a : ℕ, a < q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ Nat.Coprime (a+2) q) → (∃ f g : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, (f n=0 ∨ f n=1) ∧ (g n=0 ∨ g n=1) ∧ (¬ (n ∈ w X ∧ Nat.Coprime n q) → f n=0 ∧ g n=0)) ∧ (∀ a : ℕ, a < q → ((w X).filter (fun n => n%q=a)).sum f = ((w X).filter (fun n => n%q=a)).sum g) ∧ (w X).sum (fun n => f n * f (n+2))=1 ∧ (w X).sum (fun n => g n * g (n+2))=0)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0066 · 构造轮筛各余类质量一致但差二相关不同的同窗权重
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0066 · Construct two weights with the same wheel marginals and different gap-two correlations

brief.zh: 选同一个 w 中的 k≡a (mod q)，令两份权支撑在 {k,k+2} 与 {k,k+2+2q}。两份权均在单位余类内。该反例检验只使用轮筛各余类质量的推导，给 TP-0052R 的局部到整体比较划出限制。
brief.en: Choose k≡a (mod q) in w. Use supports {k,k+2} and {k,k+2+2q}. Both weights are supported on unit classes. This counterexample tests deductions that use only the wheel marginals and gives a limit for the local-to-global comparison in TP-0052R.
